_comment: Extracted functions that nothing calls. Every entry here is dead code that
we have decided not to remove YET -- an allowlist entry is a debt record,
not an approval. `verdict` is the twin_compare.py classification against the
inline copy still running in engine.py.
Adding an entry requires a reason and a phase. Removing one is how the work
gets proved: when a function is wired in or deleted, its line disappears.

allowed.reason: Extracted, tested, and marked Done in core-engine-wiring/README.md:65 on the reasoning that it was 'resolved for free' when a callee was wired. Wiring a callee does not wire the caller: nothing imports this module and the full 273-line inline copy still runs. The copy builds CloseTradeContext(bridge, starting_balance=...) where the live path uses engine.py:534 _make_close_trade_ctx(), which also carries tp_cache, scale_out_last_fail, tp_safety_net_last_alert, on_profit, schedule_profit_sync and background_close_commentary. Wiring it as-is would silently drop six collaborators.
